ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of approximately 4:1 white-to-black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial lobes are dominated by high-intensity white pixels. Low-intensity black pixel clusters are mapped to the peduncle insertion, the perimeter of the median notch, the truncated left distal edge, and as a series of linear streaks in the upper-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left trailing edge is characterized by high-amplitude, irregular jagged breaks. Right trailing edge displays a more continuous curve with low-amplitude, high-frequency micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe follows a convex parabolic arc. The left lobe lacks a standard sweep, presenting a truncated, roughly vertical distal boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 6-8 distinct parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the medial-right lobe surface; one horizontal linear disruption on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical trauma characterized by the missing distal section of the left fluke lobe (amputation); anomalous brown-hued pixel cluster present at the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'rib-cage' or comb-like black pigmentation pattern localized on the inner right fluke lobe.
